definitions.explanation: The direction where the sun sets.

examples.japanese: ⟦{西口|にしぐち}→西口：21655_nishiguchi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please exit from the west exit.
The school is west of my house.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{西|にし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{歩|ある}くと→歩く：00538_aruku⟧、⟦{左|ひだり}→左：00628_hidari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: If you walk west on this road, there's a big hospital on the left.

notes:
{西|にし} is one of the four cardinal directions, where the sun sets.

THE FOUR DIRECTIONS:
- ⟦{東|ひがし}→東：02250_higashi⟧: east
- {西|にし}: west
- ⟦{南|みなみ}→南：00652_minami⟧: south
- ⟦{北|きた}→北：00644_kita⟧: north

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{西口|にしぐち}→西口：21655_nishiguchi⟧: west exit (at stations)
- ⟦{西日本|にしにほん}→西日本：27538_nishinihon⟧: western Japan
- ⟦{西洋|せいよう}→西洋：01446_seiyou⟧: the West, Western countries
- ⟦{西側|にしがわ}→西側：27563_nishigawa⟧: west side

USAGE:
With locations, use ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ or ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{西|にし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (west of the station). For movement: {西|にし}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (go west).
